proposition: The dissertation's own figures do not agree on his age at death: its computation puts birth in 770/1369 (age 59 lunar years in Rajab 829), which gives about 65 at death on 14 Dhū l-Ḥijja 835, while page 57 says he died at the age of 63. This arithmetic is the recorder's, not the dissertation's.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I/II, as reported by Melvin-Koushki
mediation.note: written to the rulers judging him; the dissertation calls the apologies the primary source for his life (pdf 75)
